IncognitoRules.title: Incognito routing rules
IncognitoRules.description: Hostnames or wildcard patterns (e.g. *.google.com) to open in InPrivate/Incognito.

TabInactivityRules.title: Tab inactivity auto-close rules
TabInactivityRules.description: Hosts whose tab auto-closes after N minutes of inactivity (works in incognito or normal tabs).

CloseIncognitoOnLock.title: Close Incognito on screen lock
CloseIncognitoOnLock.description: If true, all Incognito windows close immediately when the workstation locks.

WarnBeforeCloseSeconds.title: Warn before close (seconds)
WarnBeforeCloseSeconds.description: Show an on-page warning this many seconds before auto-close. 0 disables the warning.
